name: Nippon Chemical Industrial Co.,Ltd.
summary: Nippon Chemical Industrial Co., Ltd. is a Japanese company that produces and distributes chemicals. Its portfolio includes inorganic chemicals such as chromium, phosphorus and lithium compounds, silicates, silica-based products and pigments, as well as industrial chemicals such as potassium permanganate, sodium sulfate and derivatives of cuprous oxide. It also serves Southeast Asia and other markets. Dating from 1893 as Nippon Seiren Co., Ltd.
